architectureDecisions.realisation: Case API and SQL state machine use caseId as the correlation, eligibility, rollout and measurement spine.
Connector identities have read-only source scopes; no source write route or permission is deployed.
SQL EvidenceEnvelope requires provenance, owner, timestamp, licence and quality before blob/index admission.
Analysis jobs cannot call approval transitions; workflow API requires named human role and evidence.
Versioned policy service returns deny on missing/invalid evidence and is enforced at API, ingestion, worker and transfer boundaries.

Citadel separates central management, connectivity and AI governance from nonproduction, production and Internal Audit assurance subscriptions; environment-specific hub-connected spokes, identities and synthetic nonproduction policy remain mandatory.
Interactive API replicas are isolated from Service Bus-triggered document jobs and have separate scaling/telemetry.

The confirmed primary/recovery design uses SQL failover, controlled ZRS-to-ZRS evidence replication, rebuildable search and shared recovery-point manifests for policy/audit consistency; exact approved regions remain fail-closed.
Internal Audit subscription and RBAC prevent delivery from issuing or changing verdict objects.
External objects remain in an isolated quarantine container/index state until licence, purpose and AI-use approval.
